feature_contract.goal: Connect actual game SM3 partial RGB and independent alpha write masks to native D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed OM state with channel-aware cache/fail-closed fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Actual game RT0 write masks (RGB-only, alpha-only, depth-only) bind to native D3D11 OM during real Draw/DrawIndexed.
Disabled, preset and independently blended RT0 states preserve correct mask; invalid masks and unsupported blend factors fail closed and cache clears at Reset.
Compile-time positive/negative C++ cases, source-bound integration regression, all five mandatory exact SHA gates.

integration_path: Read original live D3D9 game Draw COLORWRITEENABLE
Translate RGB/alpha/disabled blend states and separate cache identity in native OM
Bind per-Draw mask-exact native D3D11 BlendState before Draw/DrawIndexed with game fallback
batch_components: Live SM3 game channel mask admission and per-Draw D3D11 OM binding
Blended/unblended masked cache key and Reset-safe lifetime
Native C++ constexpr and source-linked positive/negative regression

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Native C++ constexpr masked blend regression plus exact SHA Windows compilation.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Out-of-range mask and unsupported blend mode fail closed; unknown game state preserves D3D9 and DXVK freeze.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Live game D3D9 Draw COLORWRITEENABLE -> cache identity -> ID3D11BlendState -> OMSetBlendState -> native Draw/DrawIndexed.
